title: Enhancements for Developing a Comprehensive AI Fairness Assessment Standard

bias_targets.methodology: Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT), projection on gender directions, Gender Bias Evaluation Test Sets (GBETs) using gender-swapped test data, and adapting embedding metrics in Large Language Models.

Tabular reduction techniques for demographic variables in images, evaluating label bias in image annotations, adapting WEAT/SEAT to assess associations with racial terms, and analyzing generated text for discriminatory patterns.
Tabular reduction techniques that convert visual attributes into tabular form for statistical analysis to reveal representational imbalances across image datasets.
Probability-based and generation-based metrics in LLMs, such as evaluating masked token probabilities and comparing model behavior on counterfactual pairs of sentences.
Probability-based and generation-based metrics in LLMs, such as evaluating masked token probabilities, pseudo-log-likelihood, and comparing counterfactual sentences.
Word and sentence embedding association tests (WEAT/SEAT) to evaluate the relationship between specific professions and traits or demographic markers.
